hero.title: Become the chef of your SushiParty!
hero.subtitle1: Those who love sushi would eat it at least once a week! Sushi is good, healthy, light, and easy to prepare. Why not try making it at home?
hero.subtitle2: SushiParty organizes themed evenings where you are the chefs, with the assistance of a qualified SushiMan.

step1.title: Where is it held? At your home!
step1.desc: You don't have to go to distant places to eat good sushi. Stay comfortable at home and invite some friends. A SushiMan will be at your disposal for the entire event.

step2.title: Who does the shopping? SushiParty!
step2.desc: SushiParty takes care of purchasing all the ingredients needed for sushi preparation. All ingredients are cut and prepared for immediate use.

step3.title: Who prepares the sushi? You!
step3.desc: In the first part of the event, the SushiMan guides you step by step starting from the easy pieces. While you eat, the SushiMan also prepares other types of sushi according to their imagination.

compleanno.title: Themed Birthday
compleanno.subtitle: Many sushi-wishes!
compleanno.desc: A nice surprise for those who are sushi-addicted.

festa.title: Themed Party
festa.subtitle: Japan dress-code
festa.desc: Share your passion for sushi and try creating your own sushi starting from the basics.

teambuilding.title: Team Building
teambuilding.subtitle: Sushi-kitchen nightmares
teambuilding.desc: SushiParty thrusts you into the sushi production chain. How many pieces will you manage to produce?

contest.title: Sushi Contest
contest.subtitle: Mom look what I learned
contest.desc: At the end of the course, students prepare sushi for their friends and relatives.

ourSushi.title: Our Sushi
ourSushi.desc: All photos are real, the sushi you see was homemade. SushiParty brings all the necessary tools including mats, knives, and other tools that facilitate the work.
ourSushi.vegDesc: Delicious pieces of sushi can be prepared without using fish or other animal products. We also show those who don't eat fish that they can enjoy sushi in hundreds of vegetarian recipes.

step1.title: Spread the rice
step1.desc: Take a seaweed and create a layer of rice. This is the base of the maki.

step2.title: Choose the ingredients
step2.desc: Combine ingredients as you like but be careful not to overfill the maki otherwise it won't close.

step3.title: Roll
step3.desc: The secret to rolling well is to apply the right pressure while preventing ingredients from coming out the sides.

step4.title: Cut
step4.desc: Cut the sushi roll into 6 or 8 pieces.

step5.title: Plate
step5.desc: Plating enhances the dish, but what will strike you is the taste.

gallery.title: Our Gallery
gallery.subtitle: Discover the beauty of our sushi creations. A feast for your eyes and taste buds!

compleanno-a-tema.longDesc: Surprise your friends and make your birthday unforgettable! A unique experience to celebrate surrounded by rice, fresh fish, and joy. Create your favorite maki and toast to your special day with a Japanese touch. Perfect for sushi lovers of all ages.

festa-a-tema.longDesc: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of Japan! Whether it's an evening with friends or an informal meeting, dress up and discover the secrets of sushi preparation. Our SushiMan will guide you from the first steps to the creation of delicious dishes in a fun and relaxed environment.

team-building.longDesc: Invite your sushi-loving colleagues to an exciting cooking challenge! Our corporate format transforms the kitchen into a real sushi maki production chain. Collaboration, coordination, and team spirit will be fundamental to winning the challenge. A perfect way to consolidate the group and strengthen corporate relationships in a tasty and fun way.

sushi-contest.longDesc: A real friendly culinary competition! After learning the basic techniques from our SushiMan, put yourself to the test by creating original compositions. Who will prepare the most beautiful and tasty dish? Your friends and relatives will act as judges to crown the champion of the evening.
